prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 5 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 6 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 8 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful, winning 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 1 test (+9.0%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.5%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and showed no clear effect in 2 tests, while copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] List Layout Redesign for Path Options: Switch the choose path screen layout to a list view highlighting immediate companion choices. (why: choose_path has an 80.9% conversion and a high mean duration of 514s; list layout simplifies option evaluation.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Pet Preservation Assurance Copy: Add explicit copy explaining that existing pet profiles, items, and progress are preserved upon signing in. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Reorder Story Sequence Before Path Selection: Reorder onboarding sequence to place story intro prior to path selection so users understand companion context. (why: Establishing narrative context earlier can reduce path selection indecision (mean time 514s, 19.1% drop-off).)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Screen Resolution & Display Multi-Monitor Info on Waiting: Display multi-monitor positioning and display resolution support notes on the waiting screen. (why: Addresses 3 support complaints regarding pets failing to display on desktop or app startup stalls.)

scores.note: Target step drops 19.1% with high time spent; layout changes show modest historical gains (+1.1%).
Strongly backed by top support theme (8 emails) and funnel drop-off; low cost copy update.
Step reordering historically reduced conversion (-3.8%) and lacks direct support email evidence.
Wait screen updates consistently yield positive results (+1.2% over 12 tests) and resolve reported user bugs.
